reason: The existing CreatureDef AI enum and generic machineDecision cannot express these nine canonical behaviors. This file is implementation input, not a claim that the rules already run.
source: docs/CANON.md D5 D8 D9 D14 D38

bindingProposal.CreatureDef: behavior?: CreatureBehaviorRules, a validated discriminated union with the nine policy kinds below; preserve the existing ai field as fallback for older content
bindingProposal.Creature: behaviorState?: serialized per-actor policy state; no module globals, clocks, hidden UI queries or Math.random
bindingProposal.BodyDef: swarm?: { densityPart: string; bloodless: true; ignoresBiologicalNeeds: true } for the non-biological-density path; do not infer this from a Def ID or a label
bindingProposal.RegionLayoutDef: no new generation hook is necessary for the finite initial population; moth activity is gated after generation and the actor/UID is preserved
bindingProposal.validation: Add the new typed fields to types.ts, generated schema, defs.ts validation and save normalization together. Resolve all item/part/season/map IDs. Fail a policy whose configured body parts or route are absent. Never use a new species ID switch as the implementation.

globalInvariants: Initial new population is exactly fifteen real actors, created by existing persisted RegionLayout spawns. No edge spawner, hourly replenishment, seasonal cloning or source regeneration is added.
A dormant moth swarm is the same actor as its active swarm. Returning to a map never awards another cohort or recreates dead wildlife.
Movement stays 100 TU under CANON D9; old lore values such as 40/50/70 TU are historical and are not silently reintroduced.
Sight is evaluated by the existing FOV/LOS/capacity path. A surveyor's species-specific 25-tile value does not change the human D38 cap.
Machine stock is the actual initial ItemInst list/components and is consumed/transferred by UID. No seed, repair part, cell or replacement culler is fabricated from a timer.
No renderer/DOM/image asset import enters core. Visual effects report actual actions and never perform the gameplay action.
A missing policy implementation blocks release activation; passing JSON schema is not a gameplay-completeness assertion.

policies.baseline: skittish AI with real Antlers/tool capacity, 13000 ml blood and one-shot carcass yields
coreChanges: Do not reuse skittish's wounded-prey branch: it makes deer hunt unconscious or bleeding humans.
Use existing scent/wind observations for avoidance, not packHunter flanking or raw-meat feeding.
Antlers use the existing tool capacity so losing that actual part prevents the antler attack. Generic code must not substitute fists.

policies.baseline: large quadruped with two actual natural attack modes and existing Grab ability
coreChanges: Select warnings, retreat and hunger from the existing actor's state/season; do not clone winter or cub variants.
A retreating target outside the sated bear's territory is released. Hungry spring bears may pursue under a configured leash.
Choose paw/bite/Grab through the existing shared attack and ability execution; don't apply unconditional damage directly from AI.
Food scent must follow actual food ItemInsts; a log mentioning smoked meat does not create a lure.

policies.baseline: generic wing/leg anatomy without a false humanoid/invertebrate kind; no default three-chunk meat drop
coreChanges: Route carrion attraction to visible/otherwise legitimately sensed original wounded actors and corpses, then retain that target's ID.
The generic skittish weak-target branch is insufficient: a conscious bleeding victim must not be pecked.
A flight movement policy must explicitly handle terrain collision, occupancy and landing. Do not simply teleport through walls or ignore all passability.
Use shared aimed combat for an eligible actual eye part; absent eyes/helmet/cover use existing rules.
Guild messenger birds and letter capsules are a separate later finite NPC/contract variant; this bundle contains only wild crows.

policies.baseline: noMorale=true and actual Tusks/tool capacity avoid ordinary morale flight
coreChanges: Apply only the recorded temporary mud coat to the natural armor calculation; remove it after real rain/washing rather than permanently stacking armor.
Aim tusk attacks through ordinary combat target selection with bounded leg weights.
Rooting may damage only an actual existing crop and increases garden alert through a shared garden event; it must not manufacture food or seed items.

policies.baseline: eight independent segments, real Head/Mandibles/VenomGlands and shared Grab ability
coreChanges: Represent overhead perching as serialized state over a real tile; shared navigation and diagonal blocking still apply when moving/landing.
Use emitted real footsteps for vibration/ambush detection. A ceiling-check action requires an action/input/UI entry if implemented.
Add part-scoped timed neurotoxin state/capacity loss on an actual landed bite. Dropped main/off equipment retains the same UID and falls to the actual floor.
Do not rebrand tetanus or a burn as neurotoxin. The current contactDisease path cannot represent local paralysis.
Poison harvesting/coating consumes the original one-shot gland with at most three doses. The new gland is presently a finite trade/material item, not an implemented coating action.
Eight generic locomotor segments permit partial movement after damage; review minimum viable breathing/blood-pumping support before actor acceptance.

policies.baseline: non-attacking draft Creature with dedicated future sprite; Body bloodMl=1 is a schema-compatible draft, not a finished density implementation
coreChanges: Add the explicit bloodless swarm/density path in body/needs/combat; do not ship bloodMl=1 as a claim that swarm density works.
Call the policy before civilian combat, so a cornered swarm never punches a human.
Read actual enabled/fuelled light sources and move toward their current original positions. The actor becomes dormant outside season/night/veil eligibility, preserving identity and prior damage.
Apply a short-lived sight/breathing hazard only to actors in the current cohort's occupied radius; use existing ash inhalation and cough events.
Consume the real lit source/extinguish state on a successful roll. A lamp icon or remembered light is not an active flame.
Deactivation moves neither actor IDs nor loot and never reissues the one-shot dust/body yield.

policies.baseline: four-leg mechanical body; real power/coolant/heat/core/tool damage; eight actual seed capsules in its initial loadout
coreChanges: Dispatch the new machine policy before TenderDrone's wreck-hauling branch. Existing generic machineDecision ignores CreatureDef.ai and would otherwise make the sower haul scrap and attack.
Loop the route while machineReady; move only by ordinary perform(move). Obstructions use the shared shove/attack rule and preserve target collision/water consequences.

Sowing transfers/consumes one existing capsule by UID; planting uses existing place/cultivation APIs on valid soil. No capsule is minted by walking or waiting, and no seed is returned twice by machine salvage.
Calling a surveyor signals the already existing surveyor actor/source. Do not create a new surveyor from an empty timer.
Fungal spray needs a bounded shared hazard/respiratory-exposure event; this fragment does not pretend the existing thermal weld mode is fungus.

policies.baseline: three-leg mechanical body and separately damageable Antenna with signal capacity; no naturalAttack
coreChanges: Dispatch before generic machine combat. Missing naturalAttack alone does not guarantee no attack: core fallback combat is not a pacifism policy.
Count only consecutive genuine LOS/thermal observations while the actual Antenna is functional. Persist interrupted progress; damaged/missing antennas cannot report.
Store shared garden alert with explicit source event and elapsed time. towerGardenAlert currently reports tower shutdown consequences and is not a general escalating garden ecosystem.
Flash is a bounded defensive effect through shared status/LOS rules and actual cooldown, never direct hidden player state mutation.
Signals may activate the finite already present culler; they never create infinite reinforcements.

policies.baseline: six-leg armored mechanical body; scythe attacks, heat/power/coolant state, real finite original salvage and shared Grab definition
coreChanges: Activate the same finite initial culler at alert3 and return it to its actual home when deactivated or damaged. Persist attacks/heat during map travel; do not replace with a healed fresh culler.
Use the existing machine.attacks count to enforce a cooling pause every four completed attacks. A windup/blocked action is not a completed attack.
Use shared Ability execution for net/Grab; generic machineDecision presently never invokes chooseAbility.

The canonical 200m leash needs an explicit world/local distance conversion. Current 64x48 local maps do not establish a meters-per-tile constant; do not silently reinterpret 200m as an arbitrary 14-tile guard radius.

DamageType currently has no acid/corrosion type. Add a validated shared chemical-attack policy for skin/eye burns and real armor durability loss, or keep purification spray explicitly pending; do not mislabel thermal weld as acid.
Finite repair consumes actual carried/stored actuator/cell/fluid UIDs using existing machineCare. Retreat is not free healing.
